notes: Governed C18 baseline snapshot only; not an OTA player release.
Runtime behavior starts from the 1i image: upstream kiosk.py plus C18 mpv_path wrapper patch.
C18 teardown hardening requests MPV IPC quit, using a fresh IPC connection if needed, before falling back to process signals to avoid panfrost faults on relaunch.
C18 playback hardening verifies the real MPV path after loadfile and playlist-next before trusting preloaded media state.
C18 disables preload_next by default so legacy configs without the field inherit the safe path.
C18 image playback hardening prepares still images as local H.264 sidecars before playlist admission because the C18 custom MPV/FFmpeg stack is video-focused and may not decode PNG/JPEG directly.
C22 media integrity rejects empty, malformed and first-frame-undecodable cache/download artifacts before playlist adoption and rebuilds invalid image sidecars.
C22 playlist adoption keeps the last-known-good content on API/download failure and exposes stale, pending and failed-media state locally and in additive telemetry fields.
C23 prevents cyclic MPV IPC backpressure by avoiding an unread persistent client in fresh-IPC mode and requiring a bounded request/response connection for each control command.
C25B gives the MPV-owned surface public loading, content-unavailable and player-recovery states in landscape and portrait without introducing a second DRM owner.

C25B binds media readiness to one MPV generation, path, configured VO and video parameters; motion media also requires observed frame progress while one-frame still-image sidecars require frame availability.
C25B renders public states as atomic one-frame H.264 assets because the production MPV build does not decode SVG; the governed SVG remains design evidence only.
C25B clears black-screen risk only after MPV-owned local frame evidence confirms that the public surface is visible.
C25B prewarms the MPV recovery surface behind the visible loading frame and persists recovery evidence immediately instead of waiting for the periodic status writer.
kiosky-player OTA remains frozen until a C18-aware player-runtime contract and hardware gate exist.
